strings.deletedsubquestion: This part of the question was deleted after the attempt was started.
strings.filloutthreeqsandtwoas: You must provide at least two questions and three answers. You can provide extra wrong answers by giving an answer with a blank question. Entries where both the question and the answer are blank will be ignored.
strings.nomatchinganswer: You must specify an answer matching the question '{$a}'.
strings.nomatchinganswerforq: You must specify an answer for this question.
strings.notenoughqsandas: You must supply at least {$a->q} questions and {$a->a} answers.
strings.notenoughquestions: You must supply at least {$a} question and answer pairs.
strings.pleaseananswerallparts: Please answer all parts of the question.
strings.pluginname_help: Matching questions require the respondent to correctly match a list of names or statements (questions) to another list of names or statements (answers).
strings.pluginnamesummary: The answer to each of a number of sub-question must be selected from a list of possibilities.
strings.privacy:metadata: Matching question type plugin allows question authors to set default options as user preferences.
strings.privacy:preference:defaultmark: The default mark set for a given question.
strings.privacy:preference:penalty: The penalty for each incorrect try when questions are run using the 'Interactive with multiple tries' or 'Adaptive mode' behaviour.
strings.privacy:preference:shuffleanswers: Whether the answers should be automatically shuffled.
strings.regradeissuenumchoiceschanged: The number of choices has changed.
strings.regradeissuenumstemschanged: The number of sub-questions has changed.
strings.shuffle_help: If enabled, the order of the questions is randomly shuffled for each attempt, provided that "Shuffle within questions" in the activity settings is also enabled. In a matching question, only the questions are affected by this parameter. The answer choices will always be shuffled.
